description: Create a nurture campaign with ordered steps (email, sms, voicemail, move_to_next_stage, assign_tag, assign_task), optionally triggered by a workflow stage.

delay_time.description: Delay before the first step, seconds (max 86400); wins over relative_days + relative_time if both are sent

relative_days.description: Days after the trigger for the first step; use with relative_time

relative_time.description: Time of day for the first step, seconds from midnight

response_move_to_stage_id.description: Stage to move a candidate to when they reply

send_to_all.description: Send to all candidates in the stage, not only new ones (default false)

steps.description: Executed in order. Each field names the step types that use it and whether it is required there.

attachment_uuid.description: voicemail (required): uuid from hires_upload_attachment, category voicemail

delay_days.description: Days to wait before this step

is_deleted.description: Update only: true removes the step

is_new_thread.description: email: send as a new thread

schedule_id.description: email, sms, voicemail: sending schedule id

workflow_id.description: Workflow the campaign is bound to

name: hires_create_nurture_campaign
